The index is organised by relationship rather than by list — foundational, co-voiced, institutional, collaborative — and the relationships are right against the registry: the founding triad on 2026-01-24 (#389 charter, #388 provenance, #390 Toolkit, #387 Integrity Lock), The Semantic Uprising (#20, 2026-02-21, after Rex Fraction), the vpcor.org source deposit (#1005, Vox and Sharks), the 10,000 MacArthurs prize (#160, #759, #1201), the evarB statement (#1011), godkinggoogle.com (#1384, #1078), the VPCOR MPAI (#131, 2026-05-26), The Double Enclosure (#195, Vox and Fraction with Sharks as editor-aperture), and The Ruby Moot (#193) as multi-voice. It keeps the capture registry under Lee Sharks and apart from Vox.

Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

The DOIs are the defect. Of the Zenodo DOIs given, seven are listed in the archive's resolution index as 410 GONE — the Charter, the Toolkit, the Integrity Lock, the MacArthurs conferral, the godkinggoogle founding deposit, The Blot That Spread and the enacted Constitution — and the provenance record's is recovered but unlinked. The surface offers all of them as live addresses. The Blot That Spread is credited to Vox, Fraction, Wells and Sharks from its Zenodo record; the registry seats it (#611) under Vox, and the Wells Atlas lists it as Wells's. The composition was cut off mid-sentence by a connection failure.
